scope: All present and future bell-electronic teaching circuits, including bells-1..4 and installation systems bell lessons

educationalModel.primary: internal virtual sealed/isolation model; no externally wireable mains primary

warning: Zil devresinde doğrudan şebeke fazı kullanılmaz; yalıtılmış uygun zil trafosu gereklidir. Yalnız sanal eğitim devresi oluşturun.
legacy: Old saved projects are not silently migrated; direct-mains bell diagrams remain in REVIEW and simulation is blocked with explicit transformer warning.
ui: Students work solely on the isolated 12 VAC secondary; the primary is not a wireable lesson terminal.
nextBatches: Fail-closed rule applies to all lessons as each 200-lesson batch is inspected.
